node.criteria: Pass if the image shows a discernible but incomplete change of the background toward a basketball court. Fail if there is no visible progress toward that change. Unknown if progress cannot be distinguished from the original or assessed reliably.
node.binding: Assess progress only toward replacing the background with a basketball court; unrelated edits do not count.
